title: WebP Screenshots
description: Save storage and do screenshots in WebP
body:
# WebP Screenshots

This Minecraft mod changes the file format for screenshots from PNG to WebP

This mod reduces the size of screenshots, in turn saving space, while not degrading quality

Example comparing 2 similar images and their sizes

![WebP vs PNG file size](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e7e78d6eb666b39df623cc9731703f5451f76b31.png)
